eeg_normalization_note: transductive: each subject's own label-free EEG statistics

metric_definitions.r: Pearson correlation per trial per axis; mean over trials, then over axes, then subjects
metric_definitions.r2: 1 - SS_res / SS_tot per trial per axis (SS_tot around the trial mean); same aggregation
metric_definitions.rmse: root mean squared error per trial per axis (target units); same aggregation
metric_definitions.nrmse: RMSE / (max - min of the true signal) per trial per axis; same aggregation
metric_definitions.pooled_r: SECONDARY, labeled: Pearson r over all samples of all trials concatenated, per axis, then mean over axes; inflated by trial-to-trial stereotypy
metric_definitions.residual_r: Pearson r per trial per axis between (prediction - T_cue) and (target - T_cue), T_cue being the cue-locked template of the training subjects; same aggregation; NaN if the prediction equals T_cue
metric_definitions.residual_r_oracle: ANALYSIS ONLY, labeled: residual_r with the template aligned on the test trial's own kinematic onset, which a real decoder cannot know
metric_definitions.residual_r_other_trial: CONTROL: residual_r with each trial's predicted residual paired with the target residual of another trial of the same subject, on their shared bins of time since LED-on; measures what is shared across trials
metric_definitions.residual_r_specific: residual_r - residual_r_other_trial per subject; the part that needs the same trial
